metadata.description: AgentAvow — signed, verifiable safety grades for the tools your AI agent connects to.

plugins.name: agentavow-trust
plugins.description: At your next session, Claude tells you which of your MCP servers and direct dependencies are safe. Anything you add with `claude mcp add` is graded before it is added. Signed 0-100 trust scores you can verify offline, plus the AgentAvow connector, a /scan command, and a per-call gate for blocked or changed tools.
